sloka: हरीणाम् उत्थितो मध्यात् संप्रहृष्ट तनू रुहः ।अभिवाद्य हरीन् वृद्धान् हनुमान् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥४-६७-८॥
transliteration: harīṇām utthito madhyāt saṁprahṛṣṭa tanū ruhaḥ ।abhivādya harīn vṛddhān hanumān idam abravīt ॥4-67-8॥

translations.english: Hanuman risen from the midst of the monkeys with his hair bristling on the body (due to expansion of body), saluted reverentially to the elderly monkey Jambavan and said :
